valuation_note: ORCL uses filed cash-flow depreciation plus intangible amortization. Current and noncurrent carrying notes already include commercial paper and other borrowings; finance-lease liabilities are added to the matching slots, and operating leases remain separate in net debt. Cash excludes separately reported investments. Gross cash PP&E purchases drive capex; noncash leased additions and the reported $260B of uncommenced lease commitments are not separately projected or added as current debt. Historical averages retain GAAP restructuring and acquisition effects. Older debt rows are unavailable where combined coverage is incomplete. This is a simplified historical-input DCF, not a valuation of contracted cloud backlog or a forecast of announced spending. A nonpositive equity result is an unfloored residual after net debt, not a stock-price estimate.
